mapper.select: select id, dates, pkg, version, user_type, total_user_num, total_exchange_count, exchange_cash_user_num, exchange_cash_count, exchange_cash_total_amount, exchange_cash_to_total_chip, exchange_cash_rate, exchange_chip_user_num, exchange_chip_count, exchange_chip_total_amount, exchange_chip_to_total_cash, exchange_chip_rate, exchange_protect_chip_user_num, exchange_protect_chip_count, exchange_protect_chip_total_amount, exchange_protect_chip_to_total_chip, exchange_protect_chip_rate, create_time from dws_daily_package_all_asset_exchange where dates = #{dates} order by id desc

SELECT ddpaae.id, duerq.dates, duerq.pkg, duerq.version, 0 user_type, duerq.total_user_num, duerq.total_exchange_count, duerq.exchange_cash_user_num, duerq.exchange_cash_count, duerq.exchange_cash_total_amount, duerq.exchange_cash_to_total_chip, duerq.exchange_chip_user_num, duerq.exchange_chip_count, duerq.exchange_chip_total_amount, duerq.exchange_chip_to_total_cash, duerq.exchange_protect_chip_user_num, duerq.exchange_protect_chip_count, duerq.exchange_protect_chip_total_amount, duerq.exchange_protect_chip_to_total_chip FROM (SELECT duer.dates, duer.pkg, duer.version, COUNT(DISTINCT duer.user_id) total_user_num, COUNT(1) total_exchange_count, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 1 and duer.to_type = 3 THEN duer.user_id END)) exchange_cash_user_num, COUNT(CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 1 and duer.to_type = 3 THEN 1 END) exchange_cash_count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 1 and duer.to_type = 3 THEN duer.from_amount END), 0) exchange_cash_total_amount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 1 and duer.to_type = 3 THEN duer.to_amount END), 0) exchange_cash_to_total_chip, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 3 and duer.to_type = 1 THEN duer.user_id END)) exchange_chip_user_num, COUNT(CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 3 and duer.to_type = 1 THEN 1 END) exchange_chip_count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 3 and duer.to_type = 1 THEN duer.from_amount END), 0) exchange_chip_total_amount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 3 and duer.to_type = 1 THEN duer.to_amount END), 0) exchange_chip_to_total_cash, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 4 and duer.to_type = 3 THEN duer.user_id END)) exchange_protect_chip_user_num, COUNT(CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 4 and duer.to_type = 3 THEN 1 END) exchange_protect_chip_count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 4 and duer.to_type = 3 THEN duer.from_amount END), 0) exchange_protect_chip_total_amount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 4 and duer.to_type = 3 THEN duer.to_amount END), 0) exchange_protect_chip_to_total_chip FROM dwd_user_exchange_record duer where duer.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY duer.dates, duer.pkg, duer.version) duerq LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_all_asset_exchange ddpaae on (ddpaae.dates = duerq.dates and ddpaae.pkg = duerq.pkg and ddpaae.version = duerq.version and ddpaae.user_type = 0)

SELECT ddpaae.id, duerq.dates, duerq.pkg, duerq.version, 1 user_type, duerq.total_user_num, duerq.total_exchange_count, duerq.exchange_cash_user_num, duerq.exchange_cash_count, duerq.exchange_cash_total_amount, duerq.exchange_cash_to_total_chip, duerq.exchange_chip_user_num, duerq.exchange_chip_count, duerq.exchange_chip_total_amount, duerq.exchange_chip_to_total_cash, duerq.exchange_protect_chip_user_num, duerq.exchange_protect_chip_count, duerq.exchange_protect_chip_total_amount, duerq.exchange_protect_chip_to_total_chip FROM (SELECT duer.dates, duer.pkg, duer.version, COUNT(DISTINCT duer.user_id) total_user_num, COUNT(1) total_exchange_count, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 1 and duer.to_type = 3 THEN duer.user_id END)) exchange_cash_user_num, COUNT(CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 1 and duer.to_type = 3 THEN 1 END) exchange_cash_count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 1 and duer.to_type = 3 THEN duer.from_amount END), 0) exchange_cash_total_amount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 1 and duer.to_type = 3 THEN duer.to_amount END), 0) exchange_cash_to_total_chip, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 3 and duer.to_type = 1 THEN duer.user_id END)) exchange_chip_user_num, COUNT(CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 3 and duer.to_type = 1 THEN 1 END) exchange_chip_count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 3 and duer.to_type = 1 THEN duer.from_amount END), 0) exchange_chip_total_amount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 3 and duer.to_type = 1 THEN duer.to_amount END), 0) exchange_chip_to_total_cash, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 4 and duer.to_type = 3 THEN duer.user_id END)) exchange_protect_chip_user_num, COUNT(CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 4 and duer.to_type = 3 THEN 1 END) exchange_protect_chip_count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 4 and duer.to_type = 3 THEN duer.from_amount END), 0) exchange_protect_chip_total_amount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN duer.from_type = 4 and duer.to_type = 3 THEN duer.to_amount END), 0) exchange_protect_chip_to_total_chip FROM dwd_user_exchange_record duer INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (dui.user_id = duer.user_id and dui.dates = duer.dates) where duer.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY duer.dates, duer.pkg, duer.version) duerq LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_all_asset_exchange ddpaae on (ddpaae.dates = duerq.dates and ddpaae.pkg = duerq.pkg and ddpaae.version = duerq.version and ddpaae.user_type = 1)
